author: Lightweight model draft for Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Run one approved task with production turned off
purpose: Lets the operator approve one named run that executes once while production stays off. Admission is recorded durably, so a restart or a restored ledger cannot reset the allowance.
serves: The Project outcome of approved work running safely and reporting back, with the operator's approval honoured.
done_when: One approved, named run completes and produces the expected file, and each refusal case is rejected by the public path.

actions.title: Run exactly one approved named task
actions.why: Stops an approved request from waiting indefinitely in pending execution while production stays off.
actions.done_when: Exactly one explicitly named, approved run is executed and recorded as complete, and an omitted, invalid, unrelated or already claimed selection is rejected.

actions.title: Keep run limits when the source or ledger changes
actions.why: A new source revision or restored ledger must not reset an allowance or allow an unrecorded attempt.
actions.done_when: Restarts and recreated fixtures keep the same goal identity and attempt counts, and reservations are recorded before any provider call, within the stated limits.

actions.title: Prove completion and refusals through the public path
actions.why: Reusable infrastructure must show completed work before a customer trial resumes.
actions.done_when: A test drives the public request path end to end and checks the result independently, rejecting a missing, wrong, stale or unrelated output.
